messages:
Anya: Heads-up: noticed latency spikes on hotpath after yesterday's kernel patch. KV warmup seems to be generating extra CPU on serving nodes. @Sam @Kai can you check ownership? Dashboard: https://dash.internal.redwood/trace/abcd :eyes:
Sam: saw that. Looks like warmup job is running on all shards; might be overlapping prefetch windows. I'll grab logs. pinging @Marta for infra load context.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2024-06-12 10:14 UTC: kernel-hotpatch-v3 -> canary (commit abc123).
Kai: Ownership: kernel perf team owns the runtime kernel but KV warmup is in prefetch service (eng-runtime/prefetch). I can take a quick look at throttle config. What perf target are we missing?
Anya: 95th latency jumped from 120ms -> 320ms for text-gen v2. Failing SLO on p99 sometimes. Repro steps: sending 50 rps of seq len 512. Logs show warmup spikes coinciding with evictions.
Sam: I'm pulling a flamegraph now. If warmup concurrency > 2 we see contention. Temp mitigation: reduce warmup parallelism to 1. Quick patch:
```
# reduce prefetch parallelism
prefetch:
  warmup_parallelism: 1
```
Marta: If we patch, can we do canary first? Ops prefers not to touch global config. We can toggle via feature-flag: runtime.prefetch.warmup_parallelism=1 for canary group.
Kai: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR for feature-flag + config guard. Sam can you test on canary? ETA ~30m.
Sam: On it. If this fixes, we should add a guard in kernel that backoffs on high CPU. Filing ticket: https://go.redwood/issue/INF-612
Anya: :party_parrot: thanks. Also, keep team updated in this thread. If degradation persists after canary, we'll rollback kernel-hotpatch-v3.
deploy-bot: Rollback suggestion queued: run `/rollback kernel-hotpatch-v3` in canary if p95 doesn't drop.
